subject: Civic Education
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of being watchful regarding the problems and challenges faced in day-to-day life.
Expresses the ability to face problems in day-to-day life should be developed.
the_entrance: The concept of problems and challenges in day-to-day life is introduced.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of problems and challenges in day-to-day life.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will identify and discuss problems and challenges they face in their daily lives.
Students will work in groups to analyze and discuss the problems and challenges they face.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations and structuring findings.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present their group findings and compare notes.
Students will answer targeted evaluation questions.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet for identifying problems and challenges
